What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals.   • Promover a parceria Escola/Família.

ATRIBUIÇÕES

1.Acompanhar os processos de ensino e de aprendizagem em parceria com a equipe pedagógica, com foco nos resultados garantindo a implementação da proposta pedagógica:

1.1 – Implementa, junto com a equipe pedagógica, o planejamento anual em conformidade com o projeto pedagógico do colégio.
1.2 – Participa, junto ao Serviço de Orientação Religiosa, do planejamento dos dias de formação e convivência.

1.4 – Promove estudos que propiciem a qualificação e atuação dos Auxiliares de Disciplina.
1.5 – Responsabiliza-se pelo processo de enturmação de estudantes.

1.6 – Mantém parceria constante com as Coordenadoras Pedagógicas de Segmento quanto ao processo de intervenção e acompanhamento dos estudantes junto aos professores.
1.7 – Elaborar em parceria com as Coordenadoras Pedagógicas de Segmento os processos de organização dos Conselhos de Classe.

1.8 – Conduz os Conselhos de Classe, orientando as discussões.

1.9 – Cumpre o Plano de Metas estabelecido a partir da Avaliação de Desempenho.

2 – Realizar gestão de processos relacionados ao desenvolvimento da aprendizagem dos estudantes considerando a excelência acadêmica:

2.1. Prioriza no plano operacional da unidade, as atividades específicas de sua função conforme a proposta pedagógica..
2.2. Estabelece foco na condução profissional das suas atividades.
2.3. Monitora o andamento da realização do plano de ação, visando à revisão de estratégias em tempo hábil.

2.4. Realiza análises quantitativas e qualitativas para respaldar as ações de intervenção junto aos alunos e às famílias.
2.5. Implementa ações que propiciem o processo de autorregulação de aprendizagem.
2.6. Orienta os professores para o acompanhamento do desempenho dos estudantes, especialmente aqueles com necessidades educativas especiais.

2.7.Efetiva projetos de formação de liderança e protagonismo juvenil em parceria com a coordenação do SOR.
2.8. Sistematiza processo de autoavaliação dos estudantes.
2.9 .Realiza projetos, junto aos estudantes, a partir de uma visão integradora dos segmentos.

2.10. Registra os processos sob sua responsabilidade.

2.11. Acompanha o desenvolvimento da aquisição das habilidades cognitivas dos estudantes, incentivando-os na construção dos hábitos de estudos.

Netvagas Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Você quer fazer parte de uma empresa de tecnologia que está há mais de 20 anos no mercado, que não apenas é parceira premier do Google Cloud, mas também já foi 4 vezes premiada como Partner of the year? Uma empresa que além de ser fera naquilo que faz, também valoriza e leva a sério o compromisso com cada IPNETER, possuindo há 5 anos consecutivos o selo Great Place To Work. Pois é, essa empresa existe. Essa empresa é a IPNET!
Além disso, somos comprometidos com a inclusão, abraçando cada forma única de ser humano, independente de etnia, gênero, orientação sexual, idade, habilidades físicas ou mentais. Por isso, todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas. Aqui, não apenas reconhecemos, mas também celebramos as diferentes identidades, experiências e talentos de cada pessoa que faz parte do nosso time.

E, estamos com uma vaga aberta para Engenheiro de Dados Sênior, que atuará dentro do nosso time de Delivery, fornecendo soluções, modelagens e arquiteturas para o fluxo de dados do nosso cliente e seus pipelines, apoiando na priorização de demandas e implementações, servindo de referência técnica aos demais do time.

Responsibilities
  • Modelagem de dados: Desenvolver modelos de dados dimensionais, utilizando as melhores práticas de modelagem para Big Data.
  • Arquitetura de dados: Projetar e implementar arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e resilientes.
  • Pipelines de dados: Construir e otimizar pipelines de ETL/ELT robustos e eficientes para dados real time ou batch de variadas origens de dados (arquivos, APIs, logs, bases SQL e No SQL).
  • Qualidade de dados: Garantir a qualidade e a consistência dos dados através de processos de validação e limpeza.
  • Otimização de desempenho: Identificar e implementar melhorias de desempenho em consultas e pipelines de dados.
  • Colaboração: Trabalhar em colaboração com outras equipes (engenharia, ciência de dados, BI) para entregar soluções de dados que atendam aos requisitos do negócio.
  • Apoiar e mentorar engenheiros de dados juniores, promovendo o crescimento técnico e profissional da equipe.
  • Documentação técnica: Capaz de documentar cada etapa de implementação do projeto, adequando a linguagem ao público-alvo.
Qualifications
  • Google Cloud: Experiência sólida com os principais serviços de dados do GCP (BigQuery, Dataflow, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, etc.).
  • Linguagens de programação: Proficiência em Python (orientado a objetos) e bibliotecas (pandas, numpy) e SQL. Conhecimento em outras linguagens como C, PHP, Java é um diferencial.
  • Modelagem de dados: Sólidos conhecimentos em modelagem relacional e dimensional com técnicas de normalização e desnormalização.
  • Arquitetura de dados: Sólido entendimento de arquiteturas de dados escaláveis, tanto para processamento em batch quanto em tempo real.
  • Data Warehouse: Experiência com BigQuery, incluindo otimização de consultas e modelagem de dados para análise.
Local e benefícios

Na IPNET, acreditamos no trabalho híbrido como forma de fortalecer nossa cultura e acelerar nosso engajamento, respeitando a flexibilidade. A proposta é trabalhar 2X na semana em home-office e 3X presencialmente em São Paulo, no escritório da Cidade Monções (Sede Eco Berrini).

Benefícios incluídos: Auxílio Refeição/Alimentação, Auxílio Transporte, Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico, Auxílio Home-Office, Wellhub, Seguro de Vida, Auxílio Creche/Babá, Happy Day no mês do seu aniversário, Parcerias com instituições educacionais.

Em FSO, apoiamos organizações a prosperar em uma era de mudanças rápidas, oferecendo serviços em disciplinas tributárias e combinando conhecimento, pessoas e tecnologia para atender às necessidades relacionadas a impostos sobre transações, impostos internacionais e questões fiscais ligadas a pessoas, conformidade e relatórios.

Por que você?

Como Gerente de Tributos, você fará parte da área de Tax com atuação na indústria financeira, com responsabilidades de consultoria tributária, gestão de projetos de compliance e impostos diretos, liderando equipes e contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos serviços de EY.

  • Liderar equipes de auditoria na revisão de cálculos, identificação de riscos e exposições;

  • Rever e preparar a apuração do imposto de renda e contribuição social, seguindo normas aplicáveis;
  • Realizar pesquisas e responder consultas tributárias de clientes;
  • Atuar na revisão e preparação da ECF (Escrituração Contábil Fiscal) e ECD (Escrituração Contábil Digital);
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos produtivos com funcionários de clientes e avaliar satisfação;
  • Supervisionar o trabalho de campo diário, informar aos supervisores sobre a situação do trabalho e gerenciar o desempenho da equipe;
  • Desenvolver as pessoas por meio da delegação de tarefas, orientação, feedback e treinamento de desempenho;
  • Contribuir com ideias para as equipes de impostos e ouvir o ponto de vista de outros membros da equipe;
  • Ter entendimento das linhas de serviço da EY e incentivar a participação da equipe na identificação de oportunidades de aplicação de serviços.
Qualificações
  • Graduação em contabilidade, direito, administração ou economia;
  • Experiência sólida em projetos que envolvam apuração de impostos diretos, com estratégias de planejamento tributário alinhadas às necessidades globais do cliente;
  • Conhecimento profundo em impostos diretos (IRPJ e CSLL – lucro real e lucro presumido) e na preparação/revisão de ECF e ECD;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Habilidade de comunicação verbal e escrita de alto nível;
  • Habilidade de trabalho em equipe e liderança.
Diferenciais
  • Experiência em projetos de suporte a auditoria, compliance e planejamento tributário;
  • Conhecimento em Digital TAX.
Quem somos

Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia, com presença em mais de 150 países. Aqui você terá a oportunidade de viver experiências excepcionais com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para apoiar seu desenvolvimento profissional.

Nossa atuação valoriza a diversidade e inclusão. Oferecemos acessibilidade para pessoas com deficiência, metodologia de trabalho assistido para pessoas com deficiência intelectual e neurodiversas, além de programas de trainee e grupos como o Abilities+ para promover um ambiente mais inclusivo.

Segundo o Great Place to Work 2023, somos reconhecidos como uma das melhores empresas para Pessoas Pretas e Mulheres no Brasil, além de apoiar iniciativas para pessoas LGBTQ+. Participe dos nossos programas e colabore para uma cultura de equidade.

Basic Function

The Director of Real Estate Finance plays a pivotal leadership role in the financial planning, investment strategy, and execution of complex real estate transactions within the Real Estate Development and Capital Asset Management (REDCAM) portfolio. Reporting to the Vice President and Chief Real Estate Officer, this role is responsible for guiding financial strategy for student housing, commercial development, acquisitions, ground leases, and joint ventures in support of the University’s strategic mission.

This position requires advanced financial acumen, a deep understanding of institutional real estate, and the ability to lead through highly complex development initiatives in alignment with the University’s strategic plan and the approved Campus Master Plan. The Director oversees financial analysis, long range capital planning, transaction structuring, and performance monitoring to ensure the portfolio supports institutional goals, adheres to risk parameters, and maintains financial sustainability. Additionally, the Director must create and support an environment that fosters teamwork, leadership development, integrity, and service responsiveness, while effectively managing relationships with business partners, regulatory agencies, and internal and external stakeholders.

Supervisory Accountability

The incumbent is responsible for overseeing the successful completion of projects, and is therefore expected to ensure all contributing parties remain on task, on time, and on budget. While this position does not have formal direct reports, the Director leads cross-functional deal teams composed of analysts, external advisors, consultants, and university stakeholders.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include executives, administrators, faculty, students, and staff of the university at large.

External contacts include housing partners, investors and lenders, consultants, contractors, local regulatory agencies, historical societies, local surrounding communities, representatives from other colleges and universities, visitors, and the general public.

Principal AccountabilitiesFinancial Analysis and Reporting
  • Conduct comprehensive financial analyses and prepare reports to assess key performance indicators and operational efficiencies.
Strategic Financial Planning
  • Long-term financial planning for the University’s real estate portfolio that anticipates and responds to legislative changes affecting higher education specifically. Develop scenario based financial models and sensitivity analysis in coordination with the Office of Data Analytics and External Affairs that incorporate potential regulatory changes, mitigate risk, and capitalize on new opportunities.
Budgeting And Forecasting
  • Support the budgeting process, implementing financial models for accurate forecasting.
Investment And Strategic Planning And Analysis
  • Support pre-transaction analysis and due diligence, including financial modeling and pro forma analysis, cost-benefit or return on investment analysis, feasibility analysis, market research, and review of third party reports such as market demand studies, environmental assessments, appraisals, facility assessment reports, among others.
  • Evaluate new investment opportunities and support the development of strategies for long-term needs and uses of the University’s real property assets including acquisitions, development, leasing, and disposition of assets.
  • Review all real estate agreements, documents, and contracts working with the Office of General Counsel to ensure compliance with the university strategic plans and procedures, and compliance with pertinent District of Columbia and Maryland laws, as applicable.
Project Support
  • Provide financial guidance to enhance property management financial efficiency and cost control. Provides support for a portfolio of real estate projects, entailing development, construction, property management, legal, and financial components.
Stakeholder Communication
  • Prepare and clearly communicate transaction analysis, financial data and strategies to university stakeholders, regarding structure, economics, mission benefits, progress, etc.
Academic Collaboration
  • Works collaboratively with the offices of the Chief Financial Officer and other members of the Administrative Services Leadership Team.
Presentation Support
  • Support the preparation of RFQ/RFP responses for all bids, ensuring compliance to policy and procedure, including zoning laws and securing public approval.
  • Preparation of materials and presentations for the Facilities and Real Estate Committee and the Board of Trustees.
Administrative Support
  • Provide administrative support as needed, including contract review and revision in coordination with outside counsel, and tracking and managing project budgets. Oversee these functions through to completion, ensuring compliance with all University processes and procedures.

Perform other related duties as assigned.

Core CompetenciesAnalytical and Strategic Thinking
  • Ability to perform complex financial underwriting, and conduct complex structuring including joint ventures, development, and debt instruments.
  • Knowledge of underwriting and closing debt and equity transactions locally, regionally, and nationally.
  • Must possess advanced analytical skills in evaluating real estate transactions.
  • Ability to gather and thoroughly analyze information in order to make well-founded recommendations to the University’s Senior Administration.
Communication, Organizational, And Interpersonal Skills
  • Demonstrate the ability to use sound judgment and to be an effective decision maker.
  • Ability to convey complex financial information clearly and build strong relationships with university and external stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail, and the ability to independently manage a transaction pipeline.
  • Excellent interpersonal, written, verbal, and analytical skills.
  • Ability to establish and maintain harmonious work relationships with students, staff, faculty, University officials, and the general public.
  • Ability to develop knowledge of, respect for, and skills to engage with those of other cultures or backgrounds is required.
Innovation And Problem-Solving
  • Creative approach to improving financial performance and operational processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to multi-task; to be a team player; and to be flexible and adaptable to change.
Technology Proficiency
  • Proven strength in the use of spreadsheets, database, and presentation applications, including Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. Demonstrated proficiency in financial modeling and analysis tools.
Minimum Requirements
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Real Estate, Economics, or related field
  • MBA with a concentration in Finance, Real Estate, or related field
  • Minimum 12-15 years of related work experience, including real estate focused banking, development, finance, underwriting, structured finance, fundamental credit analysis, consulting, urban planning, and/or public policy; including experience with institutional or public-sector projects.
  • CFA or CAIA candidate status is strongly preferred.
  • 15 years of related work experience may be substituted in lieu of educational qualifications.
  • Strong analytical, financial modeling, and reporting skills.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and project management abilities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and financial software.

title: Well Site Leader - Development
description:
Overview

Job Description:

Sub-Discipline: Operations

Specialism: Operations - Wellsite Leader

Primary Reporting: Wells Superintendent

The Well Site Leader of the Future (WSLf) program is a structured program that will include Safety Leadership, Core Technical and Leadership Training to building Core Technical Skills, and Cross-Discipline learning / Broadening with a strong focus on Performance. The program also includes frequent progress reviews that will be used to verify that the WSLf candidates are progressing through the program.

The Well Site Leader (WSL) role will support the planning and execution of well construction (drilling and completion), workovers, interventions, and subsea activities in alignment BP\'s Who We Are framework, conformance with the requirements of BP\'s Operating Management System (OMS), practices and procedures, and with local government regulations.

The Well Site Leader of the Future (WSLf) candidate will be responsible for learning and building the vital skills and competencies to function in a Well Site Leader (WSL) role after they have completed (graduated) the program. The base case duration of the program is two to three years. The length of time the candidates spend in the program will depend on the level of skills to build, their pace of learning and the level of experience the candidates bring into the program.

Successful candidates will report directly to the Well Superintendent (WSUP). They will work closely with the Well Site Leaders and Supervisors at the well site including all vendors, suppliers, and contractors.

Essential Role Requirements

Experience: Sufficient related well engineering or well operations experience including operator engineering experience. Experience working in and multi-disciplinary teams is helpful.

Note: candidates with incremental validated experience will be considered in the selection process.

Qualifications: Communication skills at all levels to be able to optimally learn the skills and competencies associated with the Wellsite Leader role and leading multi-disciplinary scopes of work.

Education: Degree in engineering, science or technical field;

Completion of WSLf training program may apply as part of the WSLf role and competency development plan dependent upon the experience of the selected candidates.

Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities

  • Promote an inclusive workplace where speak-up is the norm.

  • Support and lead in contractors, suppliers, and vendors performance for all well operations such as KPI metrics; efficiency - productive, non-productive, and invisible lost time events, investigations, non-conformance; performance feedback.
  • Actively participate in assuring safe operations. Understand and support Stop the Job and speak up culture. Participate in risk assessments and in the event of any activity or program changes.

While Working Onshore:

  • Support well planning and learning process through input into drilling procedures, forward programs and active participation in BP's continuous improvement processes. Participate in Well Program reviews with the Engineering team and ensure onsite lessons are gathered and shared effectively.
  • Management and control of operational costs. Actively pursue cost saving and innovative solutions for well work operations.
  • Develop and demonstrate communication skills in finding opportunities safety improvements and improvements in operational efficiency.
  • Support systematic sharing of takeaways and procedures identified and collected at the rig site.
Key Competencies
  • Core: Personal & Process Safety, Procedures and Practices, OMS, Risk Assessment and Management.
  • Field Specific: General Rig and Well Operations competency and development, Wellsite Leader leadership and competency development in-role.
Development & Training
  • CBSP training, water survival and other training as required to obtain approval for travel to the offshore wellsite.
  • Complete and close out gaps identified in WSL competency assessment.
  • Valid Well Control Certificate (WellSharp or IWCF) for Drilling and Well Servicing for Surface and Subsea BOP desirable
Leadership and Behavioural Traits
  • Proactively lives BP's Who We Are framework, including Code of Conduct
  • Informed Judgment: Uses good practice and sound judgment to deliver safe and driven Well Operations. Knows when to call out appropriate issues or request help. Focus on life-of-well reliability - a key outcome of well construction.
  • Commitment and Engagement: Shows personal commitment to delivering the plan, focused on Continuous Improvement
  • Systematic Management: Progresses operational excellence through systematic application of OMS
  • Leadership Presence: Demonstrates courage to safely handle risk
  • Accountability: Verifying expectations and accountabilities for safety compliance and performance are clear, accepted and delivered
  • Standout Colleague: Interfaces and enables others to realize their fullest potential
  • Safety Leader: Serves as a role model for others
  • Good Communication Skills: Able to connect with individuals of a diverse group of backgrounds, education and social status
Key Relationships

The Development WSL will need to cultivate relationships with the bp well operations team and with the rig contractors and well service personnel supporting the assigned rig. Other key relationships include the Wells Operations team and bp Wells Rigor Team (for engagement in training associated with skill development).

Site or Region Specific Accountabilities & Responsibilities
  • Develop an awareness and compliance to Local and Governmental regulations pertaining to wells Brasil operations.
Desirable Criteria & Qualifications

PPFG and geohazard principles for wells, Wellbore geomechanics, Drill string component selection, Drilling operations, Directional drilling, Drilling, Completion & Intervention fluids, Casing design, Tubular handling and installation for wells, Cementing, Drilling data acquisition and well monitoring, Run pressure drilling, Well operations under utmost conditions, Side-track operations, Casing and wellhead recovery, Wellbore fishing operations, Completion tubing design, Completion equipment & accessories, Sand control design, Intelligent Completions, Perforating, Wellbore cleanout, Well testing equipment & operations, Artificial lift, Fracturing and stimulation, Slickline and braided-line, Electric-line, Coiled-tubing, Rig workovers, Through-tubing fishing, Well interventions data acquisition, Subsea control systems for well operations, Completion landing string systems, Open-water riser and riser-less intervention systems, ROV deployment for well operations, Selection and design of subsea equipment, Subsea BOPs, Subsea tree systems, Subsea wellheads, Well control, Well intervention pressure control, Source control for wells, Crisis and emergency response management, Well barrier design, selection and construction, Well barrier operation, monitoring and maintenance, Well reliability. description:
Senior Software Engineer I, Manage Company

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Overview

The Company You’ll Join Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence. Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure. Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital. For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You\'ll Solve

As we continue expanding beyond Venture Capital into Private Equity markets, we’re building solutions to address the unique challenges of clients managing companies and funds structured as LLCs. These entities vary widely in contractual structures and represent diverse asset classes, requiring a flexible and scalable data model that supports distinct product experiences. Additionally, Private Equity firms, their investors, legal partners, and portfolio companies interact with our platform through different user personas and permissions, making robust access control and tailored experiences essential.

As a Senior Engineer on this team, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the next generation of ownership management products. You’ll work closely with product, design, and go-to-market teams—as well as directly with top-tier Private Equity firms and enterprise-scale clients—to deeply understand their needs and deliver high-quality technical solutions.

The Team You\'ll Work With

You’ll be joining our Asset Management LLC Captable team. We launched the Carta LLC product in 2020 and, after discovering a repeatable go-to-market motion, have been on a journey to scale it across the entire portfolio of Private Equity companies. We’re also expanding to support a wide range of ownership management workflows. The scope and impact of each individual on the team are immense. We are biased toward action and believe in the mantra: build → measure → learn. As part of our team, you\'ll work closely with product managers and designers to understand the motivation (why) behind a customer need, define the scope of work (what), and collaborate with your engineering peers to build solutions (how) that deliver meaningful customer value.

About You

You deeply care about your user and are relentless in your pursuit to build delightful user experiences that wow the customer! You are energized by solving deep problems collaboratively who can easily transition between a Solver and Tech Lead archetype. Additionally,

  • You have 5+ years of full-stack or backend engineering experience.
  • You are passionate about some elements of our tech stack (ReactJS, Java, Datadog, REST / GRPC, Kafka, K8s, AWS)
  • You are excited to work with stakeholders across engineering, product, business and marketing.
  • You have a desire to become a product domain expert and refine ambiguous product requirements to deliver customer value.
  • You see communication as one of your strengths.
  • You want to build and own your work end-to-end.
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.
The Interview Process

Carta follows a standard tech startup interview process, where you will meet with a recruiter and hiring manager first. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real-world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode-style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly-linked list) and virtual interviews. During the process, you can ask questions to people across different parts of the Fund Administration team to learn what kind of work we do and how it lines up with your interests.

title: Senior Well Site Leader
description:
Overview

The Wellsite Leader (WSL) is accountable for leading all activities, HSSE, operations, and logistics at the well site for related well construction activities (drilling and completion), workover and intervention, with the goal of meeting or exceeding performance metrics. The WSL is the BP site representative for Wells and will lead Wells and Contractor Personnel to ensure that well operations under their control are carried out in a manner that adheres to BP's Who We Are framework, conforms to the requirements of BP's OMS, practices and procedures, and aligns with local government regulations. The WSL is a safety critical role due to the impact of the decisions they make on operations.

While working onshore, the WSL is embedded in the operations team and accountable for supporting planning and execution activities for well construction activities (drilling and completion), workover and intervention activities with the goal of meeting or exceeding performance metrics. The WSL ensures adherence to BP's Who We Are framework, is conformant with the requirements of BP's OMS, practices and procedures, and stays in sync with local government regulations. The WSL supports the development of junior staff and ensures lessons and experience are transferred across rig lines.

Experience

Significant well operations experience, with sufficient experience working at the well site in a supervisory position. Experience working in and preferably supervising multi-disciplinary teams.

Qualifications

Excellent social skills with the ability to communicate at all levels to effectively handle multi-disciplinary scopes of work.

Successfully completed or undertaking a WSL competency assessment.

Valid Well Control Certificate (WellSharp or IWCF).

BOSIET or HUET training for locations that require helicopter transit to the Wellsite.

Education: Minimum of a High School Diploma or equivalent.

Desirable Education: Degree in engineering, science or a technical field.

Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities
  • The WSL establishes the leadership culture-setting priorities and ensures they are agreed to and understood at site inductions, daily meetings and pre-job meetings.
  • BP's lead representative on a well site, primarily leading a team of contract workers, assuring procedural subject area is followed.
  • Accountable for running daily operations planning, ensuring the plan is fully understood, communicated to onsite Sr Contractor representatives, cascaded to personnel performing the work and fully understood.
  • Commitment to well planning and learning processes through input into drilling procedures, forward programmes and active participation in BP's continuous improvement processes. Participates in Well Program reviews with the Engineering team and ensures onsite lessons are gathered and shared effectively.

  • Stop the job and assess risk in the event of any program changes or changes to risk mitigation barriers. Inform the WSUP of any changes to the risk profile of planned activities.
  • Accountable for ensuring Well Control procedures are understood and implemented by the Wellsite team.
  • Lead the planning, coordination and prioritization of materials and logistic operations to and from the Wellsite.
  • Verifies the awareness, understanding and conformance to both the Well Control and SMS Bridging documents with the Wellsite teams.
  • Owns the maximizing efficiency initiative to measure performance, highlight and implement opportunities for improvement.
During Onshore Operations
  • Commitment to well planning and learning process through input into drilling procedures, forward programmes and active participation in BP's continuous improvement processes. Participates in Well Program reviews with the Engineering team and ensures onsite lessons are gained and shared effectively.
  • Demonstrates strong communication skills in finding opportunities for improvement in operational efficiency, emerging risks, and safety concerns.
  • Systematically shares takeaways and procedures across teams and rig lines.
Key Competencies
  • Core: Personal & Process Safety, Procedures and Practices, OMS, Risk Assessment and Management.
  • Subject area: Life of Well Design, Equipment Integrity Assurance, Well Integrity, Well Control, Well Performance, Slick Line, Electric Line, Coil Tubing, Tubular Handling, Cementing, Drill String Handling, Wellhead and Tree Installation, Directional Drilling and Surveying techniques.

  • Provide support and coaching as vital to ensure the safe and efficient execution of activities.
  • Mentor and supervise the development of less experienced WSLs and engineering staff that may be at the rigsite for development and exposure to well operations.
Leadership and Behavioral Traits
  • Proactively lives BP values, including Code of Conduct
  • Informed Judgment: Uses good practice and sound judgment to deliver safe and driven Well Operations. Knows when to bring up appropriate issues or request help. Focus on life-of-well reliability - a key outcome of well construction.

description:
Senior Software Engineer I, Manage Company

Job title: Senior Software Engineer I, Manage Company

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As we continue expanding beyond Venture Capital into Private Equity markets, we’re building solutions to address the unique challenges of clients managing companies and funds structured as LLCs. These entities vary widely in contractual structures and represent diverse asset classes, requiring a flexible and scalable data model that supports distinct product experiences. Additionally, Private Equity firms, their investors, legal partners, and portfolio companies interact with our platform through different user personas and permissions, making robust access control and tailored experiences essential.

As a Senior Engineer on this team, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the next generation of ownership management products. You’ll work closely with product, design, and go-to-market teams—as well as directly with top-tier Private Equity firms and enterprise-scale clients—to deeply understand their needs and deliver high-quality technical solutions.

The Team You\'ll Work With

You’ll be joining our Asset Management LLC Captable team. We launched the Carta LLC product in 2020 and, after discovering a repeatable go-to-market motion, have been on a journey to scale it across the entire portfolio of Private Equity companies. We’re also expanding to support a wide range of ownership management workflows.

The scope and impact of each individual on the team are immense. We are biased toward action and believe in the mantra: build → measure → learn. As part of our team, you\'ll work closely with product managers and designers to understand the motivation (why) behind a customer need, define the scope of work (what), and collaborate with your engineering peers to build solutions (how) that deliver meaningful customer value.

About You

You deeply care about your user and are relentless in your pursuit to build delightful user experiences that wow the customer! You are energized by solving deep problems collaboratively who can easily transition between a Solver and Tech Lead archetype. Additionally,

  • You have 5+ years of full-stack or backend engineering experience.
  • You are passionate about some elements of our tech stack (ReactJS, Java, Datadog, REST / GRPC, Kafka, K8s, AWS)
  • You are excited to work with stakeholders across engineering, product, business and marketing.
  • You have a desire to become a product domain expert and refine ambiguous product requirements to deliver customer value.
  • You see communication as one of your strengths.
  • You want to build and own your work end-to-end.
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.
The Interview Process

Carta follows a standard tech startup interview process, where you will meet with a recruiter and hiring manager first. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real-world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode-style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly-linked list) and virtual interviews. During the process, you can ask questions to people across different parts of the Fund Administration team to learn what kind of work we do and how it lines up with your interests.

Disclosures
  • We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the talent partner via email.

description:
It's not just about your career or job title… It's about who you are and the impact you will make on the world. Because whether it's for each other or our customers, we put People First. When our people come together, we Expand the Possible and continuously look for ways to improve what we create and how we do it. If you are constantly striving to grow, you're in good company. We are revolutionizing the way the world moves for future generations, and we want someone who is ready to move with us.

Essa posição é para atuar em regime presencial, em Juiz de Fora, MG.

Com quem você vai trabalhar?

O departamento de Integração é responsável por garantir que as principais etapas de cada projeto sejam concluídas com qualidade, dentro do prazo e alinhadas aos requisitos de nossos clientes. A posição de Especialista de Integração é estratégica e abrange a liderança em processos, ferramentas e metodologias que suportam a área de Testes Integrados.

O especialista atuará como referência em DevOps, controle de qualidade, metodologias ágeis e práticas modernas de engenharia, orientando a equipe e apoiando a gestão no planejamento, execução e melhoria contínua.

Como você fará a diferença?

Como Especialista de Integração, você será responsável por atuar como facilitador ágil em projetos de Integração, garantindo a aplicação das melhores práticas em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, Scrumban). Definir e manter processos de DevOps, integrando ferramentas de CI/CD, automação de testes e pipelines de entrega contínua. Apoiar a governança de ferramentas de controle, como sistemas de gestão de testes, versionamento de código, rastreamento de defeitos e acompanhamento de métricas.

Implementar práticas de Quality Assurance (QA) e qualidade de processos, definindo indicadores e promovendo retrospectivas para evolução contínua. Atuar como ponte entre equipes globais (Brasil, EUA e Índia), garantindo consistência nos processos e comunicação eficaz. Orientar analistas (júnior, pleno e sênior) na execução de testes, uso de ferramentas e adoção de metodologias ágeis. Propor e implementar melhorias estruturais no laboratório de Integração, automatizando rotinas e otimizando processos de testes. Apoiar a liderança na definição de estratégias e roadmaps de entrega.

O que queremos saber sobre você?

  • Formação em Engenharias, Ciência da Computação ou áreas afins.

  • Experiência prática com DevOps (CI/CD, pipelines, integração contínua, automação de testes).

  • Vivência sólida como Scrum Master ou líder ágil em projetos de tecnologia.

  • Conhecimento avançado em ferramentas de controle de versão (Git, SVN), rastreamento de defeitos (Jira, Azure DevOps, IBM ELM, etc.) e gestão de testes.

  • Conhecimento na distribuição de demandas e acompanhamento de esforço desprendido em tarefas dos projetos executados pelos membros do time.

title: Staff Application Security Engineer
description:
Overview

Staff Application Security Engineers, Ledn is interested in hearing from you!

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full time Staff Application Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both the tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems. You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches. In addition, you will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments. This is a hands-on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

Responsibilities
  • Application Security: Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams. Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services. Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD. Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features. Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.
  • Authentication & Identity: Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications. Enhance existing Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens). Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows. Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.
  • Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves): Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads. Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs. Migrate high-value operations (e.g., cryptographic and financial processes) into enclave environments. Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.
  • Additional Security Domains: Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least-privilege IAM and secure key management. Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring). Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks. Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.
What You Bring To Ledn
  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review. Understanding of software supply chain. Deep understanding of Linux internals. Remediate vulnerabilities identified in the penetration test report.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.
Nice To Haves

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Ubuntu Server is the world’s most popular Linux distribution for cloud and bare metal. In this role, you will manage the team delivering cloud-init – the standard for customizing cloud instances – to the world.

Cloud-init supports various distributions and underlying platforms. This provides an opportunity to work with cloud providers to add features and integrations, the cloud-init community, and distributions to update builds and coordinate needs. You will own the product, influence its evolution, and interact with many teams and partners to coordinate new features, enhancements, and integration into various platforms.

The successful applicant will be passionate about the future of cloud-init, mindful of the dynamics of the open source ecosystem, and aware of the needs of large, innovative customers. This is an exciting opportunity for a leader who values strong teams, open source software, and Ubuntu.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. We recruit on a global basis and operate with a distributed team across 75+ countries.

title: Staff Frontend Engineer
description:
Overview

Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours. We are feeding the world’s curiosity!

The Opportunity

Cint is looking to raise the bar on engineering standards as well as user experiences. We offer a smaller company atmosphere, where engineers can shape technical strategy, lead cross-team initiatives, and set the direction for how we build and deliver products at scale. Our products are redefining experiences within the industry—join us to help define the future of our platform while multiplying the impact of the teams around you.

We’re seeking a Staff Frontend Engineer to join our UI Engineering team. This team focuses on providing frontend solutions to multiple projects and tooling to the whole company. We are deeply committed to advancing our frontend architecture (Next.js), ensuring alignment with our Design Systems, and collaborating with backend teams to deliver consistent, reliable, and user-friendly experiences across the platform.

What You Will Do

As a Staff Frontend Engineer, you will join our globally distributed team to shape and elevate Cint’s Measurement, Survey Platform, and Design System experiences. Your mission is to craft high-quality, scalable user interfaces that power our core research products and deliver intuitive experiences for our customers while enabling internal teams to move faster with confidence.

You will be a product-oriented and platform UI engineer, taking full ownership of the end-to-user experience. This includes partnering closely with UX designers, product managers, and fellow engineers to understand customer and stakeholder needs for both external user-facing products and internal products like our survey platform and design systems.

Responsibilities
  • Partner closely with Product Managers and UX designers to deliver polished, user-centric experiences and support product rollouts.
  • Create scalable and maintainable frontend components, while enhancing and extending our shared Design System.
  • Monitor and optimize application performance, resolving bottlenecks proactively.
  • Lead cross-team technical initiatives, set architectural direction, and ensure alignment on frontend strategy across the organization.
  • Proactively shape engineering practices, propose improvements, and influence standards adopted by multiple teams.
  • Advocate for and document best practices in frontend development.
  • Own and architect systems or product areas end-to-end, designing solutions that scale across multiple teams and business domains.
  • Build strong cross-functional relationships to ensure smooth collaboration and alignment.
  • Write clean, modular, and maintainable code that stands the test of time.
  • Continuously improve and refactor existing codebases for reliability and efficiency.
  • Take responsibility for production systems through on-call rotations, ensuring stability and fast incident resolution.
  • Mentor and sponsor engineers at all levels, building future technical leaders and spreading best practices throughout the company.
  • Anticipate organizational and architectural challenges, define long-term strategies, and drive adoption of solutions that improve scalability, reliability, and developer experience across Cint.
QualificationsWhat We Are Looking For
  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time driving cross-team technical initiatives and architectural decisions.
  • Highly proficient in Next.js 14+ (App Router), including expertise in data caching strategies and performance optimization.
  • Proficient in UI rendering architectures (SSR, CSR, SSG, ISR) and the ability to determine their appropriate application.
  • Expertise in designing and implementing robust UI solutions using TypeScript, with a strong focus on comprehensive typing across the stack.
  • Experience breaking down product documents into feature epics and user stories, driving features from concept to reality promptly.
  • Experience with CSS and Tailwind, and working with Figma and internal design systems.
  • Track record of building reliable, performant systems and establishing testing and quality practices adopted across teams.
  • Strong communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to define and drive technical standards across multiple teams or product lines, aligning stakeholders and ensuring adoption.
  • Experience balancing trade-offs between technical debt, speed, and long-term scalability to advance organizational goals.

More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired GapFish (the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region) and in January 2022 completed the acquisition of Lucid, a programmatic research technology platform with access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Estruturar e manter os processos de ingestão de dados de múltiplos serviços, sistemas e fontes externas da plataforma focando em alta performance e qualidade dos dados;
  • Entender profundamente a plataforma técnica para identificar novas fontes e evoluções necessárias, com suporte do time de tecnologia;
  • Você será a "Força" do time de Engenharia de Dados dentro dos squads de tecnologia e deve ser capaz de entregar de ponta a ponta as demandas específicas, alinhando processos, dependências e suporte com o time do CoE de Dados;
  • Criação e sustentação de pipelines de integração dos dados do ambiente de produção por CDC;
  • Otimização do processamento dos dados para alta disponibilidade;
  • Soluções de integração de dados externos (parceiros e outros sistemas), via API, FTP ou consumo direto de flat files;
  • Orquestração de todas as dependências (pré e pós) e garantida de entrega;
  • Mapeamento de evolução da plataforma de dados e adequação a novas implementações técnicas;
  • Manutenção de Estruturas de Dados para consumo específico, como Data Marts e Feature Stores;
  • Implementação das regras globais de arquitetura e governança de dados.

O que você precisa ter

  • Big Data | Tecnologias, Soluções e Conceitos como Spark, Hadoop, Hive, MapReduce, Kafka;
  • Cloud Computing | Azure, AWS, GCP;
  • Workflow | Control-M e/ou AirFlow;
  • Storage Solutions | Redshift, Parquet, Delta;
  • Estatística | Análise Descritiva, probabilidade, inferência, bootstrapping, testes de hipótese, regressão;
  • Data Modeling | Landing, Cleaning, Processing, Curation, Estruturas de Fato/Dimensão, encadeamento de ETLs, Data Marts;
  • Lógica de Programação | Escrever e revisar queries em banco de dados, usar parâmetros, criar variáveis;
  • SQL | Porque dado em planilha é coisa do passado;
  • Dremio, Looker, Metabase ou outras plataformas de Self-Service de dados | Para se colocar sempre no lugar do cliente;
  • Python ou R | Para quando a coisa fica bem séria;
  • Scala & Spark | Trabalhar com grande volume de dados sempre pode ser mais rápido;
  • Inglês | Nossa expansão de operação tem vários países no planejamento.

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

Regime de Contratação

CLT.

  • Espanhol | Nossos times globais estão baseados em Madrid.

Manter-se atualizado quanto às normas e procedimentos internos relativos às investigações e prevenção a fraudes.

Auxiliar na criação de materiais e apresentações para reporte à gestão, além de apoiar na elaboração e revisão de diretrizes e procedimentos do departamento.

O ambiente é multicloud (AWS, GCP e OCI), com foco em AWS e GCP.

title: Biological / Chemistry Subject Matter Exper (Master/PHD)
description:
Job Title:

Biological & Biomedical Sciences / Chemistry Subject Matter Expert – AI Training & Content Development


About Innodata:

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a global leader in data engineering and AI-powered technology solutions , trusted by 2,000+ enterprise customers worldwide, including 4 of the top 5 global technology companies . With operations in 13 cities and a workforce of over 5,000 experts across the United States, Canada, the UK, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel, and Germany , Innodata is at the forefront of artificial intelligence (AI), natural language processing (NLP), and large language model (LLM) innovation.


We combine cutting-edge ML/AI technologies , deep scientific expertise , and high-security infrastructure to deliver next-generation solutions for industries spanning pharma, life sciences, healthcare, technology, finance, and law.


About the Role:

We are seeking Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in Biological & Biomedical Sciences and Chemistry to join our AI/ML model training and content development team. In this role, you will leverage your scientific expertise to curate, validate, and create domain-specific content that improves AI reasoning, knowledge representation, and performance in life sciences and chemical sciences.

You will directly contribute to the training of advanced LLMs and scientific AI systems by developing datasets, reviewing model outputs, and ensuring alignment with scientific accuracy, regulatory compliance, and ethical standards.


Key Responsibilities:

Content Creation & Knowledge Engineering:

  • Develop scientifically accurate, domain-rich datasets in:
  • Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, and Genetics
  • Pharmacology and Biomedical Engineering
  • Chemistry (Organic, Inorganic, Physical, Analytical, Computational)
  • Cell and Developmental Biology, Immunology, Microbiology
  • Biotechnology, Toxicology, and Chemical Engineering
  • Produce high-quality scientific content, including:
  • Research abstracts and technical white papers
  • Experimental design summaries
  • Standard operating procedures (SOPs)
  • Analytical chemistry workflows and chemical reaction mechanisms
  • Biomedical case studies, drug development datasets, and molecular pathway analyses


AI Model Evaluation & Data Refinement:

  • Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, reproducibility, and compliance with scientific and safety standards.
  • Identify and correct conceptual errors, dataset biases, or incomplete knowledge representations.
  • Contribute to knowledge graph development and ontology engineering for biological and chemical datasets.


Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration:

  • Collaborate with AI engineers, data scientists, and computational chemists to optimize model reasoning.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software Back-End - Sênior (Data Platform)
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Falando da área: Trabalhar na área de Engenharia da Neoway mantém o colaborador conectado com a inovação, ao constante aprimoramento por melhores metodologias de desenvolvimento e a novas tecnologias para atender os objetivos estratégicos e de negócios da Neoway.

Utilizamos metodologias ágeis por princípio e focamos no ciclo de desenvolvimento de produto para oferecer a melhor experiência aos nossos usuários. O time de Engenharia é responsável por construir, evoluir e sustentar todo o ecossistema que compõem nossa plataforma de Big Data Analytics, chamada Plataforma Neoway.

Acreditamos que um software de qualidade é fácil de usar, funciona corretamente, é de fácil manutenção/sustentação, fácil integração e mantém a integridade para evitar possíveis falhas, fora ou não, do controle de quem o desenvolveu.

Para alcançar este objetivo atuamos em dois pilares distintos para garantir a eficiência do processo de desenvolvimento de software assegurando a qualidade junto a um ambiente saudável na área de Engenharia, no aspecto de boas práticas e cultura de desenvolvimento:

  • 1° - Pessoas é um pilar estratégico para Neoway, atuamos de maneira pró ativa em conjunto com todas as áreas da empresa, garantindo o desenvolvimento de talentos, crescimento profissional e formação do nosso DNA, impulsionando a cultura de times de alta performance (liberdade com responsabilidade).
  • 2° - Técnico (Paved Way), acreditamos que ferramental e a automação ajudam a dimensionar a capacidade de um time, mas nenhuma ferramenta resolverá todos os problemas na produtividade no desenvolvimento ou nas operações. A ideia é ter um conjunto de ferramentas e práticas de “paved way” que são formalmente suportadas por algumas pessoas. Não exigimos a adoção desses “paved way” , mas incentivamos a adoção, garantindo que o desenvolvimento e as operações usando essas tecnologias sejam uma experiência muito melhor do que não usá-las.

Falando do time: O foco do time de Data Platform é impulsionar a estratégia de Plataforma de Dados e Big Data na Neoway, fornecendo ferramentas, estabelecendo padrões e oferecendo suporte para que os times de dados possam acelerar o desenvolvimento de produtos, aumentando a celeridade e a autonomia desses times.

#Missão do cargo

Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software no time de Data Platform, você será responsável por criar ferramentas e soluções para as pessoas engenheiras de dados da empresa, atuando desde a concepção até o lançamento em produção de soluções de coleta e integração de dados. Seu objetivo será simplificar e abstrair a plataforma, tornando-a mais eficiente e fácil de usar. Suas responsabilidades incluirão evoluir nosso motor de ingestão de dados, desenvolver protótipos para provas de conceito, manter nossa plataforma de dados na cloud (GCP) e realizar o troubleshooting da plataforma com métricas customizadas. Em um ambiente inovador e colaborativo, você agregará conhecimento técnico ao time, sustentando, evoluindo e construindo soluções para nossa plataforma, garantindo a segurança, qualidade do código e arquitetura, visando um trabalho harmônico em equipe.


Responsabilidades:

  • Trabalhar na concepção de soluções técnicas, na quebra de tarefas, planejamento e na execução das demandas;
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas através da participação ativa em Code Reviews e do desenvolvimento de testes unitários e de integração;
  • Manter, monitorar e garantir a eficiência dos serviços construídos e de responsabilidade do seu time;
  • Participar das dinâmicas de trabalho adotadas pelo time;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa no processo de melhoria contínua do seu time;
  • Colaborar nas definições de arquitetura e escalabilidade dos nossos produtos;
  • Desenvolver e aprimorar a Plataforma de Dados da Neoway;
  • Propor e criar ferramentas e pipelines de dados eficientes;
  • Manter e otimizar a plataforma de dados para ingestão, coleta e distribuição dos dados;
  • Fomentar e evoluir a cultura de engenharia de software no time;
  • Oferecer suporte e consultoria aos engenheiros de dados da plataforma;
  • Trabalhar com linguagens de programação de backend como Golang e Python;
  • Criar soluções com base em uma arquitetura distribuída e de microserviços;
  • Criar soluções resilientes e que estejam dentro dos padrões de alta performance;
  • Demonstrar prudência e cuidado no gerenciamento de grandes volumes de dados;


Para assumir estas responsabilidades você precisa ter as seguintes habilidades:

  • Apresentar boa comunicação, pois somos um time bastante pró ativo e com necessidade de articulação de ideias;
  • Encarar as mudanças como oportunidades e aprender com seus erros.
  • Conhecer sobre processo de desenvolvimento de software, da concepção à entrega e subsequente monitoramento;
  • Facilidade em compartilhar conhecimento com seus pares;
  • Promover o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão;
  • Saber como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutar do trabalho em equipe;
  • Ter experienciado práticas com Code Review e Feedback;
  • Conhecimento avançado em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação;
  • Conhecimento de desenvolvimento na linguagem Golang;
  • Experiência na construção de APIs REST;
  • Experiência em execução de sistemas baseados em containers (Docker);
  • Experiência nos processos de versionamento de código (Git) e práticas de CI/CD;
  • Experiência com banco de dados relacionais e/ou não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB);
  • Conhecimento de infraestrutura e Cloud, de preferência GCP;
  • Conhecimentos básicos sobre Big Data, como por exemplo Datalake, catálogo de esquemas e metadados;


Alguns diferenciais que estamos de olho. Mas não se preocupe caso não tenha, ajudamos você nessa parte:

  • Ter sido responsável por um projeto de ponta a ponta, incluindo desenvolvimento, deploy e monitoramento;
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e sustentação de sistemas baseados em arquitetura de microsserviços;
  • Experiência com Infra as a Code (Terraform e Ansible);
  • Experiência com Kafka;
  • Experiência com Kubernetes;
  • Experiência com processamento distribuído (e.g., Spark);
  • Expertise com governança de dados: qualidade, linhagem de dados e segurança;
  • Conhecimento avançado sobre Big Data e Plataformas de dados;
  • Experiência com processamento de dados em batch com Apache Beam
  • Experiência com Apache Iceberg
  • Ter trabalhado em time de plataforma na área de Big Data;
  • Desenvolvimento focado no usuário, desde a concepção até o feedback contínuo;

title: Médico Endocrinologista (RQE)
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia ;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.


REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento e deploy de modelos de machine learning em ambientes de produção.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Python, MLFlow e Databricks.
  • Experiência com Unity Catalog para governança e segurança de dados.

- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.
